banner:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server: nginx/1.24.0
Content-Type: text/html
Content-Length: 0
note: RFC 7231-shaped response with an nginx Server header; the http rule group captures product nginx + version verbatim.

FALSE-POSITIVE GUARD: OpenSSH answers any non-SSH input with this line before dropping the connection. It must NOT fire any rule — the ssh rules anchor on ^SSH-, and a hard claim from this banner would poison every silent port 22.
FALSE-POSITIVE GUARD: Postfix answers non-SMTP input with 554; smtp rules anchor on greeting (2xx) banners, so this must stay silent.
